title: List After Page Change Indicator

illustrates.quote: Insert a blank line between a page change indicator and a list. (See Sample 8-1: List After Page Change Indicator on page 8-13.)

blocks.features: End of a paragraph carried over from the previous print page.
Print page-change marker with the new print page number, centered above the number, which is right-aligned.
Three one-line questions, no markers or bullets, plain roman text.

items.text: How might a dress code help create a safe school environment?
What are two common causes of fires in the home?
What should you do if you are outside and a tornado strikes?

print.printFeatures: Plain running text; the page-change marker and new page number are centered/right-aligned between the end of one print page and the start of the next; the three questions follow directly on the new print page.
